lines.en: label mollycafe25p2:
scene nightsky
Molly and I walk relatively close together for the duration of the trip or...side quest or...whatever you want to call it.
lines.zh: 这一路上——或者这次支线任务，或者随你怎么称呼——我和 Molly 走得相当近。

lines.en: I’m not too worried about whatever rewards it will yield considering that, if this were some sort of role playing game, I would either be the final boss or an overpowered hero character.
lines.zh: 我不太在意它最后能给出什么样的奖励，因为如果这是什么角色扮演游戏，我要么是最终 BOSS，要么是强得离谱的主角。

lines.en: Someone who everyone else either aspires to be or inherently fears.
lines.zh: 一个让其他人要么渴望成为、要么天生畏惧的存在。

lines.en: Or somewhere in between, but carrying over the best sides from both ends of the spectrum and packing them neatly into one tiny box known as “me.”
lines.zh: 又或者介于两者之间，却把两端最好的部分都继承下来，整整齐齐地塞进一个名叫「我」的小盒子里。

lines.en: Of course, it would be no game at all if there weren’t other people I met along the way.
lines.zh: 当然，如果一路上没有遇到其他人，那就称不上是什么游戏了。

lines.en: Tonight, my companion is a [young_girl] who was not even born in this section of the world.
lines.zh: 今晚，我的同伴是一个[young_girl]，她甚至不出生在这个世界的这一片地方。

lines.en: And while I can’t imagine her being of much use in terms of defeating enemies, she brings with her an aura that, more often than not, manages to bleed into and inspire others.
lines.zh: 虽然我想象不出她在打倒敌人方面能有多大用处，但她身上带着一种气场，往往能渗透进别人身上，鼓舞到他们。

lines.en: Or annoy them.
lines.zh: 或者惹恼他们。

lines.en: The effects are random, of course. And sometimes the aura is so clearly disadvantageous that, before you know it, you’re attempting to compensate for what she lacks.
lines.zh: 效果当然是随机的。有时候那股气场明显是负面的，以至于你回过神来时，已经在试图弥补她所欠缺的东西。

lines.en: If that doesn’t sound like a party member you’d take on your journey, you can chalk it up to the fact that I am no game designer.
lines.zh: 如果这听起来不像是你会带上路的队友，那只能归咎于我不是什么游戏设计师了。

lines.en: I don’t know what is good or what is bad.
lines.zh: 我不知道什么是好，什么是坏。

lines.en: I’m just naming the things I see before me and attempting to connect them to a bigger picture and kill the silence that has consumed the air where her aura so typically lies.
lines.zh: 我只是把眼前看到的东西一一命名，试着把它们连成一幅更大的画面，顺便打破这片沉默——那沉默吞噬的，正是平时充斥着她气场的空气。

lines.en: The wind picks up as we wander into the park Otoha plays in.
lines.zh: 我们溜达进 Otoha 常去玩的那个公园时，风大了起来。

lines.en: We walk past her bench and I resist the urge to draw comparisons between her and the girl she “lost” to.
lines.zh: 我们走过她那张长椅，我忍住了拿她跟那个让她「输掉」的女孩做比较的冲动。

lines.en: If Molly even considers it a loss in the first place and not just some...obstacle on the way to her next game.
lines.zh: 前提是 Molly 一开始就把这当成一次失败，而不只是……通往她下一款游戏路上的某个障碍。

lines.en: That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: I’m sure this will all blow over just as quickly as it began.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，这一切会像它开始时一样迅速地平息下来。

lines.en: Kind of like the wind.
lines.zh: 就像这阵风一样。

lines.en: scene mollywind1
: Arise, spirits of the night! And to arms, my fae companions!
lines.zh: : 醒来吧，夜之精灵！拿起武器，我的妖精同伴们！

lines.en: : I draw on your power in this time of need, for the world has begun to spin once more and left me behind.
lines.zh: : 在这危急时刻，我汲取你们的力量，因为世界又开始旋转，却把我抛在了身后。

lines.en: scene mollywind2
: Ahh, yes! It spins even now...
lines.zh: : 啊，没错！它此刻仍在旋转……

lines.en: : And as the ground beneath my feet trembles...and the oceans swell with the pulsating, overinflated abdomens of gods of yore...I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 脚下的大地震颤……海洋因远古众神那搏动着、肿胀过度的腹部而涨起……我能感觉到它。

lines.en: : Silence, friends. For you may feel it too.
lines.zh: : 安静，朋友们。因为你们大概也感觉得到。

lines.en: : And though that feeling may cause you quite the fright, ‘tis fine! For as my guide is the light that brings you vibrance, your presence is the light that guides me home!
lines.zh: : 尽管那种感觉可能会让你们惊惧，但无妨！正如我的指引是为你们带来生机之光，你们的存在，就是指引我回家的光！

lines.en: scene mollywind3
: Help me, dearest friends...for I have seen thou when no one else did.
lines.zh: : 帮帮我吧，亲爱的朋友们……因为在无人看见你们的时候，我曾见过你们。

lines.en: : And I have felt thou in the same winds that blow through these lands tonight and chills my bones to their core.
lines.zh: : 我也在这片土地上今夜吹拂的同一阵风中感受过你们，那风冷彻我的骨髓。

lines.en: : Be here for me, as I have been there for you.
lines.zh: : 请为我而在此，正如我曾为你们而在。

lines.en: scene mollywind4
: And please, if you truly do exist at all- grant me your strength.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你们当真存在的话——请赐予我你们的力量。

lines.en: : If you don’t really know if whatever you’re talking to exists or not, why talk to them or...{i}it{/i} at all?
lines.zh: : 如果你根本不确定自己正在说话的对象存不存在，那你为什么还要跟{i}它们{/i}说话？

lines.en: scene mollywind5
: I wish I had an answer for that, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我也希望自己能回答这个问题，先生。

lines.en: : You see, I’ve spent most of my life talking to things that aren’t really there in the hopes that...if they {i}are{/i}, they’ll know I believed in them.
lines.zh: : 您看，我这辈子大部分时间都在跟其实并不存在的东西说话，只盼着……万一它们{i}真的{/i}存在，它们会知道我是相信它们的。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because magic, Sir. Duh.
lines.zh: : 因为魔法啊，先生。这还用问。

lines.en: : Imagine how amazing life would be if you could manipulate the elements or...fate...or...pull power out of the ether and convert it into anything you wished for.
lines.zh: : 想想看，要是你能操控元素，或者……命运……或者从以太中抽出力量，把它变成任何你想要的东西，人生会有多美妙。

lines.en: : I think that would be spectacular.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那一定壮观极了。

lines.en: : So if there is anything out there that {i}has{/i} that power, all I wish is to see it.
lines.zh: : 所以如果世上真有什么东西{i}拥有{/i}那种力量，我唯一的愿望就是亲眼见到它。

lines.en: : And maybe channel a fair bit of it into myself for personal use, but only if those gifting it would be willing.
lines.zh: : 也许还会把其中一部分导进自己体内供我自用，但前提是赐予它的一方心甘情愿。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t want to ask for too much, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，我也不想奢求太多。

lines.en: : Well, I hope that whatever you’re talking to exists as well, since that was kind of the reason we came out here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我也希望你说的那些东西真的存在，毕竟我们大半夜跑出来，本来就是为了这个。

lines.en: scene mollywind6
: Would you like to try as well, Sir? Communicating with the fae, I mean.
lines.zh: : 您也想试试吗，先生？我是说，跟妖精沟通。

lines.en: : Yelling at trees in the middle of the night? I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 半夜三更对着树大喊大叫？我就算了。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what a fae is.
lines.zh: : 我连妖精是什么都不知道。

lines.en: : ‘Tis not just {i}one{/i} thing, Sir. The fae encompass all fairies.
lines.zh: : 那可不是单一的{i}一种{/i}东西，先生。妖精包含了所有的仙灵。

lines.en: : Aos Sí...Clurichaun...Púca.
lines.zh: : Aos Sí……Clurichaun……Púca。

lines.en: : Those are words, alright.
lines.zh: : 这些确实是词，没错。

lines.en: : Not just words, Sir. Legends.
lines.zh: : 不只是词，先生。是传说。

lines.en: : And not just legends either. They’re characters in tales from not just Ireland, but all over the world.
lines.zh: : 而且也不只是传说。它们是故事里的角色，不只是爱尔兰的，而是全世界的。

lines.en: : Every country you can think of has their own myths...their own creatures that people believe exist, but just can’t gather enough proof for.
lines.zh: : 你能想到的每一个国家都有自己的神话……都有自己那种人们相信其存在、却怎么也搜集不到足够证据的生物。

lines.en: : If such a thing exists all across the globe, I don’t think it’s fair to dismiss them without giving them a little more time.
lines.zh: : 既然这种东西遍布全球，我觉得不给它们多一点时间就这么否定掉，是不公平的。

lines.en: : They could always just be shy.
lines.zh: : 说不定它们只是害羞罢了。

lines.en: : So...all of these {i}allegedly{/i} made-up creatures from all over the world can also be known as the fae?
lines.zh: : 所以……世界各地这些{i}据说{/i}都是虚构出来的生物，也能统称为妖精？

lines.en: scene mollywind7
: For the sake of helping you understand, sure. We can summarize it like that for now.
lines.zh: : 为了帮您理解，当然可以。我们暂时就这么归纳吧。

lines.en: : Wow. Look at you actually {i}helping{/i} me understand this time instead of just saying a bunch of things and expecting me to learn them right off the bat.
lines.zh: : 哇。看看你，这次居然真的在{i}帮{/i}我理解，而不是一股脑说一大堆、指望我立刻就学会。

lines.en: scene mollywind8
: I’ve tried to help you many times, Sir! You’re just always very quick to tell me you don’t care.
lines.zh: : 我试过帮您很多次了，先生！只是您总是很快就甩出一句您不在乎。

lines.en: : Probably because I don’t.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我确实不在乎。

lines.en: : See? You just did it again.
lines.zh: : 瞧？您又来了。

lines.en: : I know what I did.
lines.zh: : 我知道我做了什么。

lines.en: : But I don’t really {i}have{/i} to care about all the same stuff as you, do I?
lines.zh: : 可我也{i}不用{/i}非得跟你喜欢同样的东西吧？

lines.en: : If I had any interests, I wouldn’t expect you to jump all over them and...be excited to talk about stuff you know nothing about.
lines.zh: : 就算我有什么爱好，我也不会指望你一头扎进去……兴奋地聊那些你一无所知的东西。

lines.en: scene mollywind9
: No...I understand. I am not looking for sympathy. I’ve been getting enough of that from the Kendo Princess lately.
lines.zh: : 不……我明白。我不是在求同情。最近剑道公主给我的同情已经够多了。

lines.en: : I need to get better at not...forcing myself onto others.
lines.zh: : 我得学着别再……把自己强加给别人。

lines.en: : I just get excited easily. ‘Tis all, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我只是太容易兴奋了。仅此而已，先生。

lines.en: : I swear it.
lines.zh: : 我发誓。

lines.en: : It doesn’t really matter to me. I’m still here, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我其实并不在意。我不是还在这儿吗？

lines.en: scene mollywind10
: Surprisingly, yes. You even allowed me to come to my power spot and everything.
lines.zh: : 意外的是，确实。您甚至还陪我来了我的力量之地什么的。

lines.en: : Well...are you feeling any more powerful?
lines.zh: : 那么……你觉得自己更有力量了吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly. It did help being able to talk to all of my friends, though. Mythical-slash-mystical or not.
lines.zh: : 也没特别有。不过能跟我的朋友们说说话确实有帮助。管它是不是神话又神秘的存在呢。

lines.en: : Great. Are we done here then?
lines.zh: : 很好。那我们完事了？

lines.en: scene mollywind11
: Aaaaaaaactually...
lines.zh: : 事、事实上……

lines.en: : Can we sit down for a little while?
lines.zh: : 我们能坐一会儿吗？

lines.en: : It’s a nice night and...I know I’ll start thinking once I get home.
lines.zh: : 今晚天气不错，而且……我知道一回到家我就会开始胡思乱想。

lines.en: : You? Thinking? That sounds dangerous.
lines.zh: : 你？思考？听起来很危险啊。

lines.en: : Haha...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Sure, Molly. We can sit.
lines.zh: : 好啊，Molly。我们坐下吧。

lines.en: : But, I’d prefer if it didn’t take up too much time since it’s only getting colder and windier as the night goes on.
lines.zh: : 不过我不希望坐太久，因为夜越深，风只会越冷越大。

lines.en: : Understood, Sir. I will do my best to annoy you for less time than normal.
lines.zh: : 明白了，先生。我会尽量比平时少烦您一会儿。

lines.en: scene black
Molly runs forward and chooses a different bench than the one right beside me, probably because she is difficult, and immediately begins looking up at the sky again.
lines.zh: Molly 跑到前面去，挑了另一张长椅，而不是我身边的那张——大概是因为她就是这么难搞——然后立刻又开始抬头望着天空。

lines.en: I’m not sure if it’s some sort of reflex for her or if she’s just doing it for momentary comfort, but I see no sense in stopping it because at least it’s bringing a smile to her face.
lines.zh: 我不确定这对她来说是某种条件反射，还是只是为了求得片刻的安慰，但我觉得没必要去阻止，因为至少这让她的脸上有了笑容。

lines.en: scene mollywind12
Instead of talking, I decide to stare at her for a little while- wondering how she’s managing to keep things together even though I know she’s being torn up inside.
lines.zh: 我没有说话，而是决定盯着她看一会儿——心里琢磨着，明明我知道她内心正被撕扯，她到底是怎么撑住的。

lines.en: In the midst of mentally listing those possibilities, a funny thought pops into my head.
lines.zh: 正当我在脑子里列举各种可能性时，一个好笑的念头冒了出来。

lines.en: What if these fae or whatever...do exist?
lines.zh: 万一这些妖精什么的……真的存在呢？

lines.en: And what if they’re just...inside of her?
lines.zh: 万一它们就……藏在她体内呢？

lines.en: Then I kick myself in the mental balls for being so corny, even if it was only in the form of an inner monologue.
lines.zh: 随后我在心里狠狠踹了自己一脚，嫌自己肉麻得要命，哪怕这只是一段内心独白。

lines.en: The more realistic answer would be that she’s already dealt with one of the worst things a person can go through in losing her mother.
lines.zh: 更现实的答案大概是：她已经经历过一个人能承受的最糟的事之一——失去母亲。

lines.en: Does that have some sort of correlation to experiencing heartbreak? Probably not.
lines.zh: 这跟经历心碎有什么关联吗？大概没有。

lines.en: But at least she’s been hurt before.
lines.zh: 但至少她以前被伤过。

lines.en: It’s always easier when you’re hurt multiple times.
lines.zh: 被伤过很多次之后，总会好过一些。

lines.en: : My foresight is telling me that you’re planning on asking me something.
lines.zh: : 我的预感告诉我，您正打算问我什么事。

lines.en: : Your foresight is pretty damn good then because I haven’t even planned on that yet.
lines.zh: : 那你的预感可真他妈准，因为我自己都还没打算开口呢。

lines.en: scene mollywind13
: What is it, Sir? Do you want to learn more about the fae?
lines.zh: : 是什么呢，先生？您想多了解一些妖精的事吗？

lines.en: : Which kind? Leprechauns? Changelings?
lines.zh: : 哪一种？小妖精？换生灵？

lines.en: : Actually...
lines.zh: : 其实……

lines.en: : Why not tell me more about your family?
lines.zh: : 不如跟我说说你的家人吧？

lines.en: scene mollywind14
: My family?
lines.zh: : 我的家人？

lines.en: : More specifically-
lines.zh: : 更具体地说——

lines.en: scene mollywind15
: Ah.
: I think our brain waves may have connected just now, for I was thinking the same thing when I was staring up at the sky.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们的脑电波刚刚可能同步了，因为我抬头望天的时候也在想同一件事。

lines.en: : But I haven’t even told you what I was thinking about yet.
lines.zh: : 可我还没告诉你我在想什么呢。

lines.en: : Then I will tell {i}you{/i} what I was thinking and we can pretend it was the same if it actually was not.
lines.zh: : 那我就先说我在想什么，如果不是同一件事，我们就假装它是。

lines.en: : Tír na nÓg.
lines.zh: : Tír na nÓg。

lines.en: : Nope. Can’t even pretend that’s what I was thinking since I have no idea what it means.
lines.zh: : 不行。我根本不知道那是什么意思，连假装都想不出来。

lines.en: : Tír na nÓg- or the Land of the Young, is a magical land not far off the Isle, where no one can die...and where everyone remains eternally young.
lines.zh: : Tír na nÓg——也就是「青春之地」，是一片离翡翠岛不远的魔法国度，那里没有人会死……所有人都永远年轻。

lines.en: : Many believe that the reason the fae will not grace us with their presence is because they reside there, Sir.
lines.zh: : 许多人相信，妖精之所以不肯屈尊现身于我们面前，就是因为它们住在那里，先生。

lines.en: : One of those people was my mother.
lines.zh: : 我母亲就是其中之一。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: So I guess Molly might actually have foresight after all.
lines.zh: 这么看来，Molly 说不定真的有预感能力。

lines.en: Either that or I’m just...incredibly easy to read.
lines.zh: 要么就是我……实在太好懂了。

lines.en: : I don’t have many memories of her, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，关于她的记忆我并不多。

lines.en: : But I do remember a large collection of storybooks and fairytales that she would read to me before she died.
lines.zh: : 但我确实记得，她去世前念给我听的一大堆故事书和童话。

lines.en: : I wish I remembered more about {i}her{/i} specifically...but I think that leaving all of those books behind was just...her way of communicating.
lines.zh: : 我真希望关于{i}她{/i}本人我能记得更多……但我想，把那些书全都留下来，大概就是……她跟我沟通的方式。

lines.en: : I wasn’t left with nothing like many other children who lose their parents are.
lines.zh: : 我没有像其他失去父母的孩子那样，被什么都不剩地丢下。

lines.en: : I still have my father...and mountains of magical myths my mother may have memorized...
lines.zh: : 我还有父亲……还有堆积如山的、母亲或许早已烂熟于心的魔法神话……

lines.en: : I have pictures of her too. And old clothes I hope to be able to wear one day.
lines.zh: : 我还有她的照片。还有她的旧衣服，我希望有一天自己能穿得上。

lines.en: : She was beautiful.
lines.zh: : 她很美。

lines.en: : Not like me.
lines.zh: : 不像我。

lines.en: : Hey, now.
lines.zh: : 喂，别这么说。

lines.en: : I doubt she’d be happy to hear you saying that about yourself.
lines.zh: : 我想她要是听到你这么贬低自己，一定会不高兴的。

lines.en: scene mollywind16
: No...It’s true, Sir.
lines.zh: : 不……这是事实，先生。

lines.en: : And I’ve known it to be true for quite some time.
lines.zh: : 而且我很久以前就明白这一点了。

lines.en: : If I was...prettier or...cooler like someone like Chika or Otoha, you and I wouldn’t be on this bench right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我也像 Chika 或 Otoha 那样……漂亮，或者……有魅力，您和我现在就不会坐在这张长椅上了。

lines.en: : I’d have won.
lines.zh: : 我早就赢了。

lines.en: : But I made the executive decision to put all of my stat points into categories that didn’t matter as much as aesthetics to some people.
lines.zh: : 但我做了一个重大决定，把所有属性点都加在了对某些人来说不如外貌重要的那些类别上。

lines.en: : Which is fine. We all have different things we look for in partners.
lines.zh: : 这也没什么。每个人找伴侣时看重的东西都不一样。

lines.en: : I just wish it wasn’t too late to change where I allotted those points, is all.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望，重新分配那些点数还不算太晚，仅此而已。

lines.en: : It’s not, though.
lines.zh: : 可是不晚啊。

lines.en: scene mollywind17
: But, Sir...you {i}have{/i} to say that.
lines.zh: : 可是，先生……您{i}必须{/i}这么说。

lines.en: : You’re the protagonist.
lines.zh: : 您是主角。

lines.en: : It’s your job to make us feel loved or wanted.
lines.zh: : 让我们觉得自己被爱、被需要，是您的职责。

lines.en: : We can’t just change who we are now after spending so many years figuring it out.
lines.zh: : 我们花了那么多年才认清自己，不可能说到改就改。

lines.en: : These are the exact years you’re supposed to be {i}using{/i} to figure it out, though.
lines.zh: : 可你现在这个年纪，本来就该{i}用来{/i}认清自己啊。

lines.en: : Even if Rin {i}doesn’t{/i} think you’re pretty, which I don’t think is the case, there are plenty of people who do.
lines.zh: : 就算 Rin {i}不{/i}觉得你漂亮——我觉得事实并非如此——觉得你漂亮的人也多得是。

lines.en: : And it might sound kind of weird, but a lot of people are really attracted to foreigners in Japan.
lines.zh: : 而且这话听起来可能有点怪，但在日本，真有很多人对外国人特别着迷。

lines.en: scene mollywind18
: Well, {i}that{/i} was mildly racist.
lines.zh: : 嗯，{i}这话{/i}有点种族歧视的味道了。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it in a bad way.
lines.zh: : 我没有恶意。

lines.en: scene mollywind19
: {i}*Sniff*{/i} No, it’s fine. I know you meant no harm.
lines.zh: : {i}*吸鼻子*{/i} 不，没关系。我知道您没有恶意。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’m overreacting. It’s just hard not to think certain things when you share literally {i}every{/i} interest with the person you like and they still won’t give you a shot.
lines.zh: : 我想我是反应过度了。只是当你跟喜欢的人几乎有着{i}完全相同{/i}的爱好，对方却连一次机会都不肯给你时，很难不胡思乱想。

lines.en: : Some people just want something different from them, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概有些人就是想要跟自己不一样的人吧。

lines.en: : Otoha isn’t that far off from Rin, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Otoha 跟 Rin 也没差那么远啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But we shouldn’t be using Rin as the basis for {i}anything{/i} when she is about as composed as...
lines.zh: : 好吧，是。不过我们不该拿 Rin 当{i}任何事{/i}的标准，她这个人镇定得就像……

lines.en: : I can’t even think of a comparison. She’s a wreck.
lines.zh: : 我连个比方都想不出来。她整个人就是一团乱麻。

lines.en: scene mollywind20
: A wreck I’ll never get to have or hold.
lines.zh: : 一团我永远得不到、也抱不住的乱麻。

lines.en: : Or get all hot and bothered with while playing h-games.
lines.zh: : 也永远没法跟她一边打 H 游戏一边打得火热。

lines.en: : No. But you {i}have{/i} kissed her before, which is more than a lot of people can say.
lines.zh: : 不。可你以前{i}吻过{/i}她，这一点很多人都说不出口。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
Not including me, of course. I’m in that same boat. But Molly doesn't need to know that.
lines.zh: 当然，我自己也在同一条船上。不过 Molly 不需要知道这个。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s fair to count what happened on Christmas as a real kiss, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我觉得把圣诞节那天发生的事算作真正的吻不太公平，先生。

lines.en: : I've done some more thinking on the matter and, as far as I’m concerned, I still haven’t had my first.
lines.zh: : 我又仔细想了想，就我而言，我的初吻还没给出去。

lines.en: : Really? Not even going to pretend you had your first with the girl you like just to make yourself feel better?
lines.zh: : 真的？连假装一下「初吻给了自己喜欢的人」来让自己好受点都不肯？

lines.en: scene mollywind21
: The only thing that makes me feel better is gaming, Sir! And anime! That is all I need!
lines.zh: : 唯一能让我好受的东西就是游戏，先生！还有动漫！我只要有这些就够了！

lines.en: : That’s so depressing.
lines.zh: : 这听起来太丧了。

lines.en: : Maybe! But this is the person I am!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！可我就是这样的人！

lines.en: : This is Molly MacCormack!
lines.zh: : 这就是 Molly MacCormack！

lines.en: : And...if you don’t like that...Go dtachtfadh an diabhal thú!
lines.zh: : 而且……如果您不喜欢……Go dtachtfadh an diabhal thú！

lines.en: : Yeah. Gothafababable and dhtafghdadadad.
lines.zh: : 嗯。哥塔法巴巴布尔，还有达塔夫瓜达达达。

lines.en: scene mollywind22
: Pfft!
: Thank you for trying, Sir. I felt quite similar when I was learning Japanese.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您愿意尝试，先生。我学日语时的感觉也差不多。

lines.en: : I did my best.
lines.zh: : 我已经尽力了。

lines.en: : But, on another note, I am done sitting on this bench. It is fucking cold.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我在这张椅子上坐够了。冷死他妈的了。

lines.en: scene mollywind23
: Then...off to the original side quest we go!
lines.zh: : 那么……我们出发去完成原本那个支线任务吧！

lines.en: : There were no physical rewards for this one, but I do believe we have increased our social link!
lines.zh: : 这一个没有实物奖励，但我相信我们的社群连结等级提升了！

lines.en: : Yeah. And we’ve grown a little closer as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我们也走得更近了一点。

lines.en: scene mollywind24
: Oh, Sir...You still have so much to learn...
lines.zh: : 哦，先生……您要学的还多着呢……

lines.en: scene black
$ molly_love += 1
$ mollycafe25p2 = True
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump mollydorm25
